judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation, leaving several unfinished facets in a committed `.lore/dod.md` scratch file. Function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource` schemas are never validated at all (`validate` is set to `undefined` at registration and never compiled or checked during `execute`), which immediately causes the candidate's own orchestrator retry test in `registry.acceptance.test.ts` to fail. Furthermore, `import Ajv from 'ajv'` in ESM NodeNext TypeScript (`src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`) will fail typecheck/runtime compared to the named import `{Ajv} from 'ajv'`. Multiple required deliverables from the ticket are completely missing: unit tests in `registry.test.ts` (for extra properties, dynamic schemas, unknown tools, etc.), the tool-loop test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and documentation updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`.
